This points to failing pcpu allocation with GFP_ATOMIC flag.

column2: transactions happen from user context and are allowed to sleep.

column1: One case where we can call into percpu allocator with GFP_ATOMIC is
Normally this happens from control plane
needs to use GFP_ATOMIC allocations (nft_dynset expression).

column2: .clone callbacks always use GFP_ATOMIC for this reason.

column1: Add gfp_t argument to the .clone function and pass GFP_KERNEL or
